node: Natural colors, flavors, extracts, and clean-label reformulation inputs
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the natural-colors and clean-label reformulation node with a two-lane bias toward underfollowed suppliers. The clearest direct exposure is Sensient Technologies, which appears to be a specialized public natural-color beneficiary of synthetic dye phase-out and clean-label reformulation. Secondary underfollowed candidates include Balchem and Hawkins as formulation/ingredient-system or ingredient-distribution beneficiaries, while Ingredion is included as a broader clean-label reformulation input supplier rather than a pure natural-color play. FDA Red No. 3 compliance deadlines create a dated regulatory pull-through catalyst, but later layers must verify segment materiality, customer conversion evidence, volume/pricing uplift, capacity, and whether management commentary ties growth to dye reformulation rather than generic clean-label demand.
